name: batch10
rows: modern black AK-74 rifle: a black adjustable telescoping stock with a cheek riser, a black receiver with a rail along the top, a long black slotted rail handguard, a black pistol grip, a long curved black magazine, a front sight and a muzzle device. No red dot, no suppressor, no foregrip, no laser.

large revolver pistol: a big grey steel cylinder, a long heavy slotted barrel shroud with a rail on top and a rail underneath, a front sight, a hammer spur at the back, a trigger guard and a large black pistol grip. No text.
sawed-off double-barrel shotgun: two short side-by-side steel barrels, a dark-brown wooden fore-end, no shoulder stock but a short curved wooden pistol-grip handle, two hammers and a trigger guard.

belt-fed machine gun: a black plastic shoulder stock, a black receiver with a hinged feed cover on top, a pistol grip with a trigger guard, a long barrel inside a slotted heat-shield handguard with a rail, a flash hider, and a bipod hanging under the front. No scope.
